all.label: All versions
all.note: Every version at once. Pick a source and watch the family rearrange itself.

groups.label: Homer & epic
groups.full: Homer, the Homeric Hymns, the Cypria
groups.note: In Homer, Atreus fathers Agamemnon, Tyndareus fathers both twins, and Iphigenia does not exist.

groups.label: Hesiod
groups.note: In Hesiod, Pleisthenes fathers Agamemnon, Zeus fathers both twins, and Iphigenia becomes Hecate.

groups.label: Lyric & tragedy
groups.note: In tragedy, Clytemnestra strikes the blow herself, and Oedipus blinds himself.

groups.label: Apollodorus
groups.note: Apollodorus records rival versions side by side: two fathers for Agamemnon, two mothers for Helen.

groups.label: Later writers
groups.note: In later writers, Nemesis is Helen’s mother and Pelops’s curse falls on Thebes.
